description: This Java class implements a command handler for creating templates within the Fineract project. It processes 'CREATE' commands for templates by delegating to the TemplateDomainService.

classes.name: CreateTemplateCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling creation of templates via command processing, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the TemplateDomainService.
